title: hieracium praecurrens subsp. scotophyllum
intro: Hieracium praecurrens subsp. scotophyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) and is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing pain and swelling, and its antiseptic properties, which help to prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
